explanation: Try every next digit block, treating its digits as one concatenated number. At each block boundary try addition or multiplication. Track the last multiplicative term so multiplication replaces that term in the running total, preserving operator precedence.
timeComplexity: O(3^n) arithmetic operations in the worst case; BigInt costs depend on the intermediate operand lengths.
spaceComplexity: O(n) recursion frames, with BigInt values retained along the recursion path.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
